name: Lunar Roving Vehicle

parts.name: Chassis
parts.role: Three-piece hinged aluminum chassis folded during flight

parts.name: Wire-mesh wheels
parts.role: Zinc-coated woven wire with titanium chevron treads
parts.snap: Wire wheels mounted. No air to go flat.

parts.name: Seats
parts.role: Foldable tubular aluminum seats designed for pressurized suits

parts.name: Mesh antenna
parts.role: High-gain umbrella mesh dish for color TV broadcast

parts.name: Control stick
parts.role: T-handle hand controller operated by either astronaut

challenge.title: Walk-back planning
challenge.intro: Drive to sample sites across the lunar landscape, but keep an eye on life support consumables: you must never exceed walking distance back to the LM.
challenge.hint: Check the oxygen reserve bar: driving further increases scientific yield, but walking back takes 10 minutes per kilometer.

signal_note: Three rovers were left behind on the Moon, their batteries long drained, standing in place.
ending: The Lunar Roving Vehicles allowed astronauts to explore kilometers beyond their landing sites.
